summary: sandbox panel isn't there if you join late or die and respawn during a sandbox game

comments.content:
I believe this was fixed in the most recent Bay12 version (released about two days
after Rick forked it). Stealing the fix would probably be the easiest thing to do.

I'm fairly sure this patch will work, but I haven't been able to test it since I'm
behind a crazy router so I can't host and let people test. It also fixes a small typo
thing in sandbox.dm where the game_mode was traitor instead of sandbox.
